mechanism: Both agents increase serotonergic activity through different pathways (MAOI vs monoamine reuptake inhibition), creating risk for serotonin syndrome; St. John's Wort also induces CYP3A4, potentially reducing MAOI levels.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if St. John's Wort must be discontinued in patients on isocarboxazid, allow 2-week washout and monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms.
